dataset_name: Arova Indic Creator Bench — M2 10-Clip Smoke Corpus
description: Verified 10-clip local speech smoke corpus sourced losslessly from pinned google/fleurs test parquets across Hindi (hi_in), Kannada (kn_in), Tamil (ta_in), Telugu (te_in), and English control (en_us). Hinglish is explicitly excluded pending verified references.
